message: refused: `id` cannot serve as stable feature identity — the file has no such column, and no identity mapping was declared. Stable per-feature identity is required (docs/11); declare a mapping to a column that carries it. Synthesizing a row ordinal instead is the hazard ADR-010 rule 2 exists to prevent
